summary: Ansible pulls dynamic inventory through inventory plugins, and you can write your own plugin. Inventory scripts in any language still work via the script plugin, but plugins get caching, configuration and constructed groups for free.
questions: Should I write an inventory plugin or an inventory script?
Can I still use old-style dynamic inventory scripts?
What do inventory plugins give me that scripts don't?

answer_card.title: Inventory plugins vs scripts
answer_card.answer_md: Inventory plugins pull data from dynamic sources like clouds; write your own if none fits. Inventory scripts (any language, JSON output) still work through the `script` plugin, but you must implement caching, configuration and dynamic group/variable composition yourself. Plugins get these features from the Ansible codebase.
